title: UI follow-ups: hero badges, sticky nav pill, desktop navbar overlap
request: Hero badges not keyboard-reachable; wrong active pill in the team-page sticky nav; Home pill overlapping the wordmark at 1024 to 1280px

criteria.text: Team-page hero badges are real buttons with an accessible name (the badge name), reachable by Tab, opened by Enter and Space and by tap, at least 44x44 with a visible focus ring, and open the same dialog as before
Badges on other pages that share the component (home Top Teams cards, /stats rows) look the same as before and are never a button nested inside a link (no nested interactive elements)
Sticky nav: the active pill matches the section in view after tapping Overview, Stats, Matchups, Matches and Career, and while scrolling; aria-current is correct
Sticky nav: the active pill is scrolled into view in the 390px bar, and each button's accessible name contains its visible words
At 1024, 1100, 1280 and 1440px the 717REC wordmark is not overlapped by the Home pill or any nav pill; the navbar is unchanged at 390, 360 and 1440
No new console errors, no sideways scroll at 360 and 390 on / , /stats and a team page and at 1024 to 1440, touched components' tests pass

reviews.summary: UI follow-ups re-reviewed at HEAD (whole task diff): desktop badges are Tab-reachable buttons with names and focus tooltips; in-link badges (home TeamCard, RankingTeamCell) have no tab stop and no nested button; RankingCard/Compact phone-only; controlled-tooltip flag cannot stick (checked in Radix source and by mutation); rAF hold fix and test verified by mutation; no suppressions in the diff; 46/46 targeted tests pass.

notes.text: From the earlier audits. Known causes: TeamBadge.tsx:143-158 is a div onClick (40x40, no role or name, Tab skips it; TeamBadgeCollection is shared with home TeamCard, RankingCard, RankingCardCompact, RankingTeamCell: check none sits inside a link); TeamDetailsStickyNav.tsx:56-79 lets the last intersecting entry win; desktop brand is squeezed to 61px at 1280 so the wordmark runs into the Home pill (Navbar.tsx).

Reviewer nits, not blocking: tooltip text repeats the badge name for screen readers; no tooltip after the dialog closes for keyboard users; title attr also shows at >=1280 where labels are visible. Behaviour changes to tell Doug: desktop badge click now opens the dialog; phone taps on badges inside the home Top Teams card link now just follow the link. Navbar signed-in/admin at 1024px simulated only.
